pages.title: Blood Plasma
pages.text: Blood with the cells taken out: water, salts, sugar and a host of proteins, the antibodies among them. It carries everything a body sends anywhere. Found in the seas and channels of Inner Space's Bloodstream; the Lake Pump draws it, without end.
Made in $(item)Lake Pump$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inner Space.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Antibody, Grown Organ, Nutrient Broth, Panacea.
